- If you move a deal out of commit, add a single-line rationale in column "Commit Note".
- Finance needs a reconciled USD amount (use the sheet's conversion tab) and the HubSpot deal id.

I've attached a first-pass rollup (EMEA_commit_rollup_sep2027.xlsx) with suggested adjustments based on recent activities and coverage notes. Please update the sheet in-line and reply with any blocking items. 

Priority accounts for this pass: EuroTech (Simon Clarke), Acme (Joe Patel), and Norstar (deal listed in the rollup).

I'll aggregate and send a consolidated snapshot for leadership at 14:00 UTC tomorrow.

Thanks —

Jordan / team —

Two quick clarifications: 

1) Currency handling: the rollup uses a single EUR->USD conversion in the conversion tab. For local-contract deals priced in GBP/SEK, should we normalize to USD using EOD FX (finance prefers end-of-day on the last business day of the reporting period). I can patch but want confirmation.

2) For deals with open procurement (PO pending but legal signed) — do we classify as "Commit" or "Late-Commit" in the sheet? We have a handful where legal is signed but PO timing is uncertain.

If we adopt "Late-Commit" it would be helpful for finance to run a small-scope waterfall so they can project cash timing.
